requirements.description: 32-bit AMO operand replication across 64-bit AXI write lanes and preservation of colliding external and atomic self-invalidation requests.
AXI shim unacknowledged AR (READ_HOLD) and W (WRITE_WAIT) stability and gated burst beat counter.
Direct round-robin arbitration and FIFO reset optimization achieving setup/hold slack >= 0.0 ns at 2.35 ns clock and area <= 6450.0 um^2.
